options.title: GotIt settings
options.subtitle: Customize how words are saved from your browser
options.interfaceDescription: Choose the language used by the extension. Automatic follows Chrome's language.
options.translationDescription: These preferences are saved in your GotIt profile and used on your other devices.
options.signedOut: Sign in through the extension popup to change translation preferences.
options.sourceHelp: In automatic mode, Google detects the text language; the website language is not considered.
options.floatingDescription: Shows a translation on double-click and a GotIt action beside selected text. Enabled by default and can be turned off at any time.
options.privacyAction: GotIt saves content only after an explicit action from you.
options.privacyData: The word or phrase, sentence, page title and URL are saved — never the HTML or full page.
options.enabled: The floating button and double-click translation are enabled.
options.disabled: The floating button and double-click translation are disabled.
options.invalidLanguage: Enter a valid language code, such as he or en.

popup.introTitle: Words you meet along the way, stay with you.
popup.introDescription: Save a word with its sentence, source site and translation — and keep everything in GotIt.
popup.privacyNote: The extension saves content only when you ask it to. Translation service keys are never stored in the browser.
popup.sourcePlaceholder: Select text on a page or type here
popup.loadSelectionTitle: Loads the current selection from the website and translates it
popup.translateGoogleTitle: Translates the word or phrase above with Google
popup.existingMeaning: You already saved this spelling — which meaning should it use?
popup.aiNotConfigured: AI translation is not fully configured on the server. Configure the Anthropic key, model name and signing secret in Render, then deploy again.
popup.translationNotConfigured: The automatic translation provider is not configured on the server. Enter a translation manually or configure Google Cloud Translation / Claude in Render.
popup.noSuggestion: The translation service did not return a suggestion. You can enter a translation manually.
popup.moreMeanings: More meanings exist in the library; consider opening the GotIt app.
popup.validSaveFields: Enter valid languages and a translation.
popup.previewChanged: The word or languages changed. Preview the translation again before saving.
popup.changesSavedDetails: “{{source}}” · You can continue viewing and editing
popup.selectMeaning: Choose an existing meaning or a new meaning.
popup.savedDetails: “{{source}}” · {{status}} · You can continue viewing and editing
popup.wordSaved: The word was saved. You can continue viewing or editing it.
popup.wordRemoved: The word was removed from saved items.
popup.loginValidation: Enter an email address and a password of at least 12 characters.
popup.noSelection: No selection was found on the page. You can type it manually.
